entities.title: Check that the vendored sign-in library is unedited
entities.summary: Samosa's Worker bundles vendor/icelander-auth, but its tests never call checkVendored(), which the library asks every repository's tests to call.
entities.compromise: test/sign-in.test.ts stands in for the login service and checks the Worker's routes, but not that the library it imports matches vendor/icelander-auth/STAMP.json. Only Rally's sign-in test calls checkVendored().
entities.cost: An edit to vendor/icelander-auth made while working on Samosa passes Samosa's tests and is deployed with its Worker; only a run of Rally's tests would notice.
acceptanceCriteria: npm test in games/dictator fails when a file in vendor/icelander-auth no longer matches STAMP.json.

origin.description: The file's opening comment: a repository's tests call checkVendored().

sources.symbol: sign-in: a new game or a score needs a sign-in; the login service out of reach is signed out
